caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a beaded bag or pouch with floral designs. The main body of the bag is black, and it is decorated with intricate beadwork in various colors, including red, blue, green, white, yellow, and pink. The bag features a flap at the top, which also has beaded floral motifs, including a yellow and white flower and blue, green, and pink elements. The lower portion of the bag contains a prominent red flower with green leaves, white and yellow flower shapes, and blue leaf-like designs, surrounded by blue and white beaded borders. The edge of the bag and flap are bordered with pink and red material, and there is a fringe of white beads hanging from the bottom of the bag. The bag is shown against a plain, off-white background with the words "ACTUAL SIZE" written below the image, and "R. ELVIS" signed at the bottom right.
title: Bag
